mhsn.review: MHSn. She curves and gives questions from what she teaches in class.
Afreen Khan She is such a sweet faculty. For grading she is great. Makes easy questions exactly copy from her slides and give good marks and curves a lot. Also she does give bonus marks on homeworks

MHSn for MAT116 is extremely good. She does not decurve. She curves (i.e. if the whole section does relatively bad, then everyone's mark will increase because NSU has a quota - 20 percent students to get A/A- from each section). Review her slides and most importantly she gives questions directly from the book without changing values. Precalculus by Michael Sullivan. Go through the book problems and solve all the book problems (at least one of each type). Do your CW and HW as she gives bonus mark at the end of semester of you show you CW and HW copy. For Maths follow the 2-4-7-10-14 method. When the CW is done, do review it the next day I.e. do just a few problems. Then 4 days later repeat it, then repeat it 7 days later..
Till 14 days. You don't have to cram at all. I got an A myself. By the way, she is very strict regarding exam timing and no makeup quizzes are taken so be sincere. Overall, GOAT-ed faculty. All the best.

Lamisa Munzarin okay so basically I guess my original review is a bit misleading if you're talking about efforts. Look if you just do 2-3 selected maths of each important example type then it's enough for an A as well. Moreover, she does curve and is friendly. Of course one does not need to solve all problems in the book, that's something I did and consequently did very well. More than what was necessary. Since this is a retake for you, just do 2-3 important types from the important examples she gives in class and you will be good to go.
